checks.message: Provisional boundary is used and labeled official_boundary=false / boundary_precision=provisional_rough; it is never presented as an official redline. Replace with official geometry before professional area scoring.

Three required key areas (zhongzhiyuan, origin community, dazhongsi) are present as provisional constraints, inside the site boundary and non-overlapping; replace with official polygons when available.
90 land-use cells derive from one cut-line network over the submitted boundary: shared edges share coordinates, union equals the boundary, no gaps or overlaps (verified by scripts/spatial_review.py).
Offline static HTML with inline SVG only; no remote assets, scripts, iframes or tracking; displayed metrics match metrics.json via data-metric markers (verified by scripts/visual_review.py).
Proposal (v2, bilingual) cites sources, standards, depth items, geometry features and metrics adjacent to claims; exhaustive coverage lives in the JSON/matrix evidence layer.
Chinese primary with complete English counterpart; EN report HTML, visual page, A3/A0 PDFs and all five text-bearing figures are paired.
All known metrics recomputed from generated geometry in EPSG:4548; statutory controls (FAR, height, total floor area) remain status=unknown pending official data.
